svg.text: The same content, two predicates. Every triangle is smaller than a tile.
Dense sheet + one prop, all class c* (blue); a foreign class in the corner (orange).

g.text: coverage claim: "is this tile covered yet?"
claimed = some ONE triangle interior covers the tile (4.2)
no triangle covers a tile interior, so nothing ever claims
presence: "is a foreign class present here?"
tile = -1 empty | c uniform | -2 mixed, from BBOXES
dashed = dropped; the backdrop is c*, so the pixels are unchanged
